scope: 15 cases × 3 passes per model. Sonnet retains the completed HIGH baseline; Terra uses 45 fresh HIGH executions through its global Bedrock profile with measured cache writes.
costBasis: Observed provider token counts multiplied by verified public list prices. Not AWS invoice totals.

sonnet.evidence: Saved deployment plus requested-model attribution for every provider response. Attribution events may repeat and are not billable-call counts.

terra.evidence: Saved deployment plus requested-model attribution for every provider response. Attribution events may repeat and are not billable-call counts.

claudeCodeSonnet.evidence: Saved command, run config, CLI init events and result modelUsage for all 45 executions. This routing check does not modify or republish the Claude Code results.

routingVerification.firstPartyAnthropicRule: Global by default; inference_geo=us applies 1.1x to all token categories for Claude 4.6 and later. The verified Sonnet runs above used Bedrock global profiles.

terra.costBasis: Observed provider counters at public list prices; excludes judge, infrastructure, tax and account discounts.

terraMethod: Per request: ((input - cacheRead - cacheWrite) × inputRate + cacheRead × readRate + cacheWrite × writeRate + output × outputRate) / 1,000,000. Rates use the ≤272K or >272K input band. Reasoning is already included in output.
cacheConditions: Implicit Bedrock caching; cache entries were not cleared between requests or passes. Costs reflect the cache reuse observed during execution.
